categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and fixes the OpenRPC schema regex emitted by getopenrpcinfo.
categories.rationale: Fixes a schema inconsistency in getopenrpcinfo where valid empty hex strings produced by methods like decoderawtransaction fail schema validation. As noted in the description, native segwit inputs produce empty scriptSig.hex values and decodescript accepts empty strings, causing schema-validating clients to falsely reject valid RPC payloads.
